FACEIT for MLBB: SKY, Lockin and Ladder

There is no FACEIT for MLBB, but there are SKY, Lockin and Ladder: a queue, ELO, roles and a game lobby. What they are and which one to pick.

In this story

  1. Why they exist
  2. SKY
  3. Lockin
  4. MLBB Ladder
  5. Which one to pick
  6. Tournaments with prizes

In this story
Why they existSKYLockinMLBB LadderWhich one to pickTournaments with prizes

In brief

  • FACEIT has no Mobile Legends, but in 2026 MLBB got its own platforms of the same kind: SKY, Lockin and Ladder.
  • They share one idea: the site gathers ten players of one level, gives each a role, the match is played in the game's custom lobby, and wins move your ELO.
  • All three are free and made by players; they are not connected to MOONTON.

Why they exist

In MLBB ranked you earn stars, and random matchmaking builds your team. Hence a jungler without Retribution and two fighters in one lane. On the platforms the rating is ELO: beating strong players gives more points, your role is fixed before the match, and AFK or throwing is punished. That is why people call them "FACEIT for MLBB", like the CS2 platform.

SKY

The platform was opened by the streamer Geass, and its beta started on 18 November 2026. It is the most complete of the three. Everyone starts at zero ELO, the first ten matches are calibration, then come levels from 1 to 10. The win, damage, gold, KDA and MVP come from the game automatically, and your rating depends not only on your team's win but on your share in it.

  • A captains draft from 1531 ELO: two captains play rock-paper-scissors and pick players in turns.
  • One-on-one duels with their own rating: before the game each player bans a hero class for both.
  • Parties of up to five, a shared chat and reports that send throwers to a low-priority queue.
  • The announcement promises cash prizes for the top of the leaderboard, games with esports players and a pro league.

Playing is free. The paid Premium subscription only gives cosmetics and conveniences. Registration is from 14 years old.

SKY website skymlbb.ru Sign-up, match rules and sign-in with Telegram, Google or the game account. ↗

Lockin

Lockin is made by enthusiasts who wanted points-based rating back in MLBB, like the old PTS system. You sign in with one click through Telegram, and the game account is checked by ID and server, so you cannot play from someone else's or a spare one. You choose your role yourself: jungle, EXP, mid, gold or roam, and in the match you play only that.

The first season is on now. To get into the top fifty of the table you need about 1320 points, and on 26 November the leader had 1574 after 96 matches. The table can be filtered by role. The Lockin app is downloaded from their Telegram channel, and matchmaking for full five-stacks is promised once there are more players.

Lockin website lockingg.cc Telegram sign-in, the leaderboard by role and the guidebook. ↗

MLBB Ladder

Ladder is the simplest of the three. You sign in without a password through a Telegram bot, then queue: the site gathers ten players and splits them into two equal teams by ELO and role. There are levels from 1 to 10, seasons, tops by role and by hero, a profile and your match history.

If the site does not open

Ladder sits behind DDoS protection: before signing in, the browser sometimes asks you to pass a check. That is normal; the sign-in page opens after it.

Ladder website mlbbladder.ru 5×5 matchmaking, sign-in through a Telegram bot without a password. ↗

Which one to pick

  • SKY if you want the most modes, to play with friends and to compete for the promised prizes.
  • Lockin if strict roles and verified accounts without smurfs matter most.
  • Ladder if you want simple matchmaking and nothing else.

Everywhere you need your own account, and signing up asks for the ID and server from your MLBB profile. Nothing stops you from joining all three and playing wherever a match is found faster.

To sign up How to find your MLBB ID and server Where the profile shows the account number and the server in brackets.

Tournaments with prizes

If you want to play for money right now, there is CyberHero by the operator t2. It runs one-on-one MLBB knockout tournaments almost every day, and on weekends the Solo Weekend Premium Cup with a prize pool of 10,000 roubles. You can take part from 18 years old.

Frequently asked questions

Is there FACEIT for Mobile Legends?

FACEIT itself has no MLBB. The same format comes from SKY, Lockin and Ladder: a queue, ELO, roles and a lobby in the game.

How much does it cost to play?

Nothing. SKY has a Premium subscription, but it only gives cosmetics.

Do I need a high rank in the game?

No. The platforms' rating does not depend on your MLBB stars: everyone starts from zero or with calibration.

Can I play with friends?

On SKY, yes, parties of up to five. On Lockin matchmaking for ready teams is promised later.
